description.INCIDENT_DETAIL_EN: Cross-boundary travel related arrangements / notes for Mainland’s National Day Golden Week holidays
description.INCIDENT_DETAIL_CN: 國慶節假期跨境陸路口岸出行的有關安排/注意事項

2026-10-03T12:00:00.CONTENT_EN: The Transport Department (TD) anticipates that more travellers would return to Hong Kong via land-based Boundary Control Points (BCPs) today (October 3) afternoon and evening, and tomorrow (October 4). The TD appeals to these inbound travellers to plan ahead their journeys and reserve sufficient commuting time. It is anticipated that the demand for public transport services will be higher during the period and the waiting time would increase. The TD has instructed public transport operators to strengthen their services to meet passenger demand. The TD's Emergency Transport Coordination Centre will continue to monitor the traffic and public transport services at all land-based BCPs, and shall disseminate the latest traffic news through the TD's website (www.td.gov.hk) and “HKeMobility”. The public may make use of “HKeMobility” to access the snapshots of traffic conditions of major connecting roads to BCPs and the inbound and outbound vehicle plazas of Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge (HZMB) Hong Kong Port, and they may also check the real time situations of the vehicle clearance plaza of HZMB Zhuhai Port through the WeChat official accounts “hzmbzhport” or “zhuhaifabu” (or visit https://traffic-info.gzazhka.com:5015/#/),inorder to plan their journeys ahead. In addition, according to Zhuhai authority’s notification, temporary traffic arrangement may be implemented in Zhuhai during return peak to facilitate vehicles traveling from Zhuhai city centre to the HZMB Zhuhai Port. For details, please refer to the following link: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/OEEKl77NNOHk19Okj9PrPg(Chineseonly).
2026-10-03T12:00:00.CONTENT_CN: 運輸署預料今日（2026年10月3日）下午至傍晚時分及明日（2026年10月4日）將有較多跨境旅客使用陸路口岸回港，運輸署呼籲入境旅客預早妥善規劃行程，預留充裕交通時間。運輸署預計在返港高峰時間的公共運輸需求會較高，乘客候車時間亦會較長。運輸署已指示公共運輸服務營辦商加強服務應付乘客需求。運輸署的緊急交通事故協調中心會繼續監察各陸路口岸的公共運輸服務情況，並會透過運輸署網頁（www.td.gov.hk）及流動應用程式「香港出行易」，發放最新的交通消息。 市民亦可透過「香港出行易」查閱陸路口岸主要連接道路以及港珠澳大橋香港口岸出境及入境客車通關廣場的交通快拍，以及透過「港珠澳大橋珠海口岸」或「珠海發布」微信公眾號內的「大橋口岸實時通關」服務（或前往https://traffic-info.gzazhka.com:5015/#/），查詢大橋珠海口岸的車輛實時通關情況，以便及早計劃行程。 此外，據珠海當局通報，珠海市於回程的繁忙時段或實施臨時交通安排，以便車輛由珠海市內前往大橋珠海口岸，詳情請參閱以下連結:https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/OEEKl77NNOHk19Okj9PrPg

Busy Traffic at the vehicle clearance plaza (HK bound) of the HZMB Zhuhai Port

The vehicle clearance plaza (Hong Kong bound) of the HZMB Zhuhai Port is very busy now. Members of the public who plan to drive their private cars back to Hong Kong via HZMB are advised to plan ahead their journeys, reserve sufficient commuting time, and be patient while queuing. The public can check the real time situation of the vehicle clearance plaza of HZMB Zhuhai Port through the WeChat official accounts "hzmbzhport" or "zhuhaifabu" (or visit https://traffic-info.gzazhka.com:5015/#/)(Chineseonly) before starting their journeys.

港珠澳大橋珠海口岸(往香港方向)的車輛通關廣場現時非常繁忙

港珠澳大橋珠海口岸(往香港方向)的車輛通關廣場現時非常繁忙，計劃駕駛私家車經大橋返港的市民請妥善規劃行程，預留充裕交通時間，同時在輪候時保持忍讓。市民可於開始行程前透過「港珠澳大橋珠海口岸」或「珠海發布」微信公眾號內的「大橋口岸實時通關」服務(或前往https://traffic-info.gzazhka.com:5015/#/)，查詢大橋珠海口岸的車輛實時通關情況。
